doc.description: Toroidal magnet (ABRACADABRA / DMRadio-GUT topology). The static field B_phi fills the rectangular box y R < r < R, |z| < H/2, wound by a poloidal winding of thickness tw. A superconducting sheath of thickness ts encloses the winding with clearance g and carries the readout current around the central hole through a meridional slit (azimuthal pickup). For a long toroid the geometry factor is g = y^2 ln(1/y), largest at y = e^(-1/2).
doc.name: toroid
